scripts.cf:typegen: wrangler types --env-file .dev.vars.example --strict-vars=false --include-runtime=false --env-interface CloudflareEnv src/cloudflare-env.d.ts && oxfmt src/cloudflare-env.d.ts
scripts.deploy: bun run build:cloudflare && bun run sentry:sourcemaps && wrangler deploy ./dist/worker/worker.js --no-bundle
scripts.dev: sh -c 'set -eu; GITHUB_OAUTH_EMULATOR_URL="${GITHUB_OAUTH_EMULATOR_URL:-$(portless get github.emulate.enterprise-agentic-saas)}"; export GITHUB_OAUTH_EMULATOR_URL; exec portless run sh ../../scripts/wrangler-dev-portless.sh'
scripts.dev:spotlight: sh -c 'set -eu; GITHUB_OAUTH_EMULATOR_URL="${GITHUB_OAUTH_EMULATOR_URL:-$(portless get github.emulate.enterprise-agentic-saas)}"; export GITHUB_OAUTH_EMULATOR_URL; exec spotlight run -p 8969 portless run bun run src/dev.ts'
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: sentry-cli sourcemaps inject ./dist/worker && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --release "$SENTRY_RELEASE" --validate --strict --wait ./dist/worker
